<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="an-overview-of-slayer" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>An Overview of Slayer</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Slayer is a combat-based skill, where XP is awarded for killing the monsters assigned to you by a Slayer Master, with harder monsters generally giving more XP. Slayer is a great way for the player to earn GP and combat XP while progressing their account, and can be trained using both low-effort and high-effort methods.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="the-basics-of-slaying"><ins><nowiki>The Basics of Slaying</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="overview"><nowiki>Overview</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Early Slayer Assignments offer low XP rates, which can be avoided with other methods, such as squashing Scarabs in Menaphos </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552289589796904.png?v=1" alt="menaphoslode" title="menaphoslode" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and completing Reaper tasks </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641341976960172043.png?v=1" alt="death" title="death" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Generally, using the highest levelled Slayer Master is recommended, with the exception of Mandrith </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150757148622921.png?v=1" alt="mandrith" title="mandrith" kind="icon" /><nowiki> who only offers Wilderness tasks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Cluster assignments are highly valued as they allow you to fight monsters above your level for high XP rates, e.g. fighting Greater Demon Berserkers for a &quot;Demons&quot; task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ AFKing assignments sacrifices XP rates for convenience, actively Slaying will always grant the player higher XP rates.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Most Slayer Masters have a chance of offering the player a unique assignment which they may accept or decline, these often give good reward for the effort needed to complete them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Notable special assignments are Laniakea's, which is well worth the effort, Morvran's, which should be completed </nowiki><em><nowiki>only once</nowiki></em><nowiki> for the Completionist Cape, and the Raptor's, which is also involved in a Completionist Cape requirement.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="utilizing-slayer-points"><nowiki>Utilizing Slayer Points</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Slayer Points are obtained by successfully completing Slayer Assignments with the amount given depending on the Slayer Master used. If you ever find yourself wanting to quickly obtain Slayer Points, you can find our guide on farming them in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ As for how to spend Slayer Points, our order of priority is:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Building a block/prefer list and upgrading your Slayer Helmet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlocking any desired Slayer Assignments, such as Nightmare Creatures.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Quality of life unlocks such as quicker killing blows and attaching items to your Toolbelt.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="managing-your-blockprefer-list"><nowiki>Managing Your Block/Prefer List</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The Block &amp; Prefer list is a very powerful tool which can be used to focus your Slaying on monsters that grant great reward, while ignoring those which the player deems a waste of time or not fun to slay. You can find our guide on finding the best block/prefer list for you in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=G8a7S4ZjIWspR9f9ozZY <nowiki>Magic preset</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/550e4e271dac792a176bdb8253cb68888c12ae9032815cbf2fb8e6de0f900385.webp" alt="Magic Slayer" kind="addition" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=uv6fuVGjCwKfxrYxrvlY <nowiki>Melee preset</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/5cf12e6a7d3e34c323caa16212fc429d6e6de19733fa773458bdb8f06ec4d4a3.webp" alt="Melee Slayer" kind="addition" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=b0acc1f2-7fe0-42e7-9844-a7851b28eb24 <nowiki>Ranged preset</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/dd022e6284168c388ce7c48807d3f51977c37d8dedea30df7e089f0e55c363c6.webp" alt="Ranged Slayer" kind="addition" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=3e5e5dc0-a3ab-473a-9d78-b59d73c92177 <nowiki>Necromancy preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F3e5e5dc0-a3ab-473a-9d78-b59d73c92177.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ These presets and relics are examples of what the player </nowiki><em><nowiki>may</nowiki></em><nowiki> bring on their assignment.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Specific relic setups and aura usage are included in our monster guides, you can view our general recommendations with the </nowiki><code><nowiki>!relics</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and </nowiki><code><nowiki>!aura</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎commands.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="ability-usage"><ins><nowiki>Ability Usage</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>We have several guides on specific Slayer Assignments with their own methods and action bar layouts, you can find them in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#rs3-slayer</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Generally, AoE abilities will be prioritized when training Slayer, below are examples of AoE abilities for each combat style.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: Chain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440203401068566.png?v=1" alt="chain" title="chain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Greater Chain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Corruption Blast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1" alt="corruptblast" title="corruptblast" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Dragon Breath </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Tsunami </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and Magma Tempest </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1" alt="magmatempest" title="magmatempest" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: Cleave </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1" alt="cleave" title="cleave" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Bladed Dive </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Quake </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1" alt="quake" title="quake" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Hurricane </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and Meteor Strike </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: Ricochet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259566186521.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Greater Ricochet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Corruption Shot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1" alt="corruptshot" title="corruptshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and Bombardment </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1" alt="bombard" title="bombard" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Mechanised Chinchompa </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1" alt="mechchin" title="mechchin" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used to make many single target abilities hit in a 3x3 AoE.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: Soul Strike </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1" alt="soulstrike" title="soulstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Blood Siphon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1" alt="bloodsiphon" title="bloodsiphon" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Spectral Scythe </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1" alt="spectralscythe" title="spectralscythe" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Death Skulls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Threads of Fate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1" alt="threadsoffate" title="threadsoffate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + any single target ability.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Tuska's Wrath </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="tuskas" title="tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> deals extra damage against your current Slayer Assignment at an increased cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="useful-items"><ins><nowiki>Useful Items</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>


</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Slayer Helmet</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • BiS helm against current assignment.
    • At 90 Slayer, prioritize building the Slayer Helmet stand on Anachronia so you don't have to wear it.
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Slayer VIP Tickets</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344597934120.png?v=1" alt="slayervip" title="slayervip" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Lets you choose between 2 assignments.
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wilder Pie</nowiki></strong><nowiki>
    • Boosts your Slayer level by 6 for 6 minutes.
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Cannons</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1114767361975779379.png?v=1" alt="dwarfmulticannon" title="dwarfmulticannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1" alt="kineticcyclone" title="kineticcyclone" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Deals AoE damage and draws aggro, Artisans' Workshop upgrade allows for automatic reloading.
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Demon Horn Necklace</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1" alt="demonhornnecklace" title="demonhornnecklace" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Restores prayer if paired with Bonecrusher </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1" alt="bonecrusher" title="bonecrusher" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (for bones) or Attuned Ectoplasmator </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1" alt="ectoplasmator" title="ectoplasmator" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (for ashes).
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Scrimshaw of Sacrifice</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1" alt="sacrificescrim" title="sacrificescrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
     • Destroys loot for increased XP. Uniques destroyed count towards logs.
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Ushabti</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097515642749468752.png?v=1" alt="ushabti" title="ushabti" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Captures monster souls used in the Sunken Pyramid and the Slayer Codex </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1" alt="slayercodex" title="slayercodex" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Slayer's Introspection</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345365471232.png?v=1" alt="slayerintrospection" title="slayerintrospection" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Lets you choose minimum or maximum possible size task.
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Drop Cleaners</nowiki></strong><nowiki>
    • Several items can help collect or consume drops automatically, such as Spring Cleaner </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1130170723130937427.png?v=1" alt="springcleaner" title="springcleaner" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Magic Notepaper </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735230908805240.png?v=1" alt="notepaper" title="notepaper" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and Artificer's Measure.
    • Your toolbelt can hold several other drop cleaning items.
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Teleports</nowiki></strong><nowiki>
    • There are many useful teleports, such as the Slayer Cape </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1" alt="slayercape" title="slayercape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and the Slayer Codex </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1" alt="slayercodex" title="slayercodex" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="perks"><ins><nowiki>Perks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>


</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Genocidal</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1" alt="genocidal" title="genocidal" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Grants a damage boost against the current Slayer target, increasing as the task progresses.
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>X-Slayer Perks</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1" alt="demonslayerperk" title="demonslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1" alt="dragonslayerperk" title="dragonslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayerperk" title="undeadslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Grants a damage bonus to the perk's respective monster type.
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Scavenging</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1" alt="scavenging" title="scavenging" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Grants Invention components when killing monsters. These stack up quickly.
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Caroming</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1" alt="caroming4" title="caroming4" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Allows Chain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440203401068566.png?v=1" alt="chain" title="chain" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Ricochet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259566186521.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and their greater variants to hit more targets.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
